translation.name: Dižaʼ chaweʼ kub len Salmo kaʼ

book.name: FILIPENSES
book.title: DIŽA' DA' BSEḺA' PABLO ḺO YEŽ FILIPOS

content: Da' naken dot chawe'
Na'a, ẕí'na'do' ka', le yebél dan' nakle toze ḻen X̱anžon'. Bi že' zedla' wzoja' chele da' yoble kan nak dan' bzoja' chele zga'ale, dan' gákḻenen ḻe'e.
Le gape chi'i kwinle chegak benne' ka' žóngake' da' ẕinnj. Zej nake' ka bia yix̱e' snia ka', benne' ka' žon byéngake' chog ḻo beḻa' chegak benne' byo ka' da' nak bia' nzí'gake' x̱tiža' Dios.

Da' nak bian' nzi'žo x̱tiža' Dios, dan' naken dot ḻi ḻaže', zóaḻenen žo'o. Dan' žejḻe'žo che Dios, yo'o Dios Be' La'y yichj ḻáẕdo'žo, na' žebelžo dan' nakžo toze ḻen Jesús, Benne' Criston'. Bi žx̱en ḻáže'žo to da' žiazen ḻo beḻa' žen chežo.
Ḻa'kze žx̱en ḻáže'žo naken ki, ḻezka' neda' de chia' to da' gak wx̱én ḻaža'a. Cha' zoa no benne' žekle' yelé' dan' zoa da' chawe' da' bene', neda' ba benža' ka da' ben bennen':

content.text: Wžóg ḻo x̱peḻa'a dan' nak bian' katen' goka' x̱ono' ža.
Golja' ladjw biche' ljež benne' Israel ka'.
Nbábḻena' ẕa'só Benjamín, ẕi'nkze Israel na'.
X̱a x̱na'a zej nake' benne' hebreo ka'.
Goka' benne' yodo' fariseo kan bka'n ẕena' Dios.
Be' ḻáže'ḻi'a x̱tiže'e ga bžinte wžía ḻaža'a benách ka' che Benne' Criston'.
Cha' wak to benne' gake' chawe' ḻaw Dios dan' žone' kan ẕnna x̱tiža' Dios, bi gok no benne' bi da' nnie' chia'.

content: Na'a, da ka' bx̱en ḻaža'a zga'ale, ba bzoan' cheḻa'ale dan' naka' che Benne' Criston'.

Kégeze da' ki, san ḻezka' bnnita' cheḻa'ale yógo'te da' zej den, nich gak gónbi'a X̱anžo Jesús, Benne' Criston', dan' záka'težen ka yógo'te da' ka'. Nich gónbi'a Ḻe' bnnita' cheḻa'ale yógo'te da' ka', na' žekla' zej naken ka bebe, nich gata' chia' da' žonn Benne' Criston' chežo,

na' nich gaka' toze ḻen Ḻe'. Beyaka' chawe', kege dan' žona' kan ẕnna x̱tiže'e, san Dios na'kze beyone' neda' chawe' dan' žejḻi'a che Benne' Criston', kan žeyone' chawe' yógo'te benne' ka' žejḻé'gake' chie' Ḻe'.

Žénezela' gónbi'a Benne' Criston', na' soaḻen yeḻa' wak che Dios neda', dan' bkonle' žin katen' besbane' Benne' Criston' ḻo yeḻa' got, na' nich gónḻena' Ḻe' tẕen, saka'a neda' kan wẕake'e Ḻe', na' nich soa' gata' kan gote' Ḻe',
dan' žx̱en ḻaža'a Dios, yesbane' neda' ḻo yeḻa' got.
Da' žonžo nich ḻa'žo latje chežo
Bi ẕnnia' ba napa' yógo'te da' ki da' gonn Dios chia', na' bi žekla' ba naka' dot chawe' ḻawe' Ḻe'. Na'a, žon byena' gata' chia' yógo'te da' ka' dan' ba wẕí' ḻo na' Jesús, Benne' Criston', neda'.
Ḻe'e, ẕí'na'do' ka', bi na' gapa' da' ki, san toze da' žon byena'. Ẕzaḻ ḻaža'a da' ba napa', na' žon byena' gata' chia' da' za'.

Žona' kan žon to benne' taría taría žitje' ḻo witje nich gata' chie' to da' yebéḻenle'. Ki žona' nich gata' chia' da' bḻiž Dios žo'o nich gatan' chežo ya'abá chie' dan' nakžo toze ḻen Jesús, Benne' Criston'.
Ki žaḻa' gonžo yógo'težo žo'o, nak dot ḻi ḻaže' kan žejḻe'žo che Benne' Criston'. Cha' žéklele báḻele žaḻa' gonle to da' yoble, ẕnnabla' Dios wzejni'ile' ḻe'e.
Na'a, kan nak da' ba nzi' ḻo na'žo, žaḻa' góntezežon.
Ḻe'e, ẕí'na'do' ka', le gon kan žona' neda'. Ba bsedlto' ḻe'e kan žaḻa' gonle. Le wia kan žongak benne' ka' žóngake' kan bento' neto'.

Ba gožkza' ḻe'e zan chi'i, na' žapa' ḻe'e da' yoble ḻen yeḻa' ẕbeže chia', ẕnnia': da' žongak benne' zan žonen ga zej nake' ka benne' ka' bi ẕḻé'egekle' Benne' Criston' chawe', dan' ẕzóagake' cheḻa'ale da' benkze' Ḻe' ḻe'e yag kroze.

Chjak benne' ka' žóngake' ki ḻo yi' gabíl dan' dios chégake' naken da' ẕzeze ḻáže'gake', na' ẕka'n ẕen kwíngake' ni'a che da' žóngake', da' ka' žaḻa' gonen ga yedoé'egekle'. Že' ḻáže'zegake' da' de yežlyó nga,
san žo'o že' ḻáže'žo da' de ya'abá che Dios gan nbabžo, na' ẕbezžo ža yeḻá' X̱anžo Jesús, Benne' Criston', Bennen' žeslé' žo'o, katen' yežoje' ya'abá che Dios.
Ḻe' wché'e beḻa' žen chežo, da' kwia yi'kzen, na' gone' ga yeyaken kan nak beḻa' žen chekze' Ḻe', da' soan to chi'ize. Ki gone' ḻen yeḻa' wak ẕen chie' da' wkonle' žin nich nna bi'e yógo'te.
